stages.name: syntax_rows
stages.query: SELECT x.__path,x.__start,x.__end,x.kind,x.text,x.line,x.parent_start,x.parent_end,x.parent_kind,x.ancestor_start,x.ancestor_end,x.ancestor_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,5,6) THEN x.name_start END AS name_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,5,6) THEN x.name_end END AS name_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,5,6) THEN x.name_kind END AS name_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,5,6) THEN x.name_source END AS name_source,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (4,5) THEN x.left_start END AS left_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (4,5) THEN x.left_end END AS left_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (4,5) THEN x.left_kind END AS left_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (4,5) THEN x.right_start END AS right_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (4,5) THEN x.right_end END AS right_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (4,5) THEN x.right_kind END AS right_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,5) THEN x.value_start END AS value_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,5) THEN x.value_end END AS value_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,5) THEN x.value_kind END AS value_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (4,5) THEN x.type_start END AS type_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (4,5) THEN x.type_end END AS type_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (4,5) THEN x.type_kind END AS type_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (1,5) THEN x.function_start END AS function_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (1,5) THEN x.function_end END AS function_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (1,5) THEN x.function_kind END AS function_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (1,5) THEN x.arguments_start END AS arguments_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (1,5) THEN x.arguments_end END AS arguments_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (1,5) THEN x.arguments_kind END AS arguments_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (2,5) THEN x.object_start END AS object_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (2,5) THEN x.object_end END AS object_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (2,5) THEN x.object_kind END AS object_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (2,5) THEN x.object_source END AS object_source,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (2,5) THEN x.attribute_source END AS attribute_source,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (5,6) THEN x.parameters_start END AS parameters_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (5,6) THEN x.parameters_end END AS parameters_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (5,6) THEN x.parameters_kind END AS parameters_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (5,6) THEN x.return_type_start END AS return_type_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (5,6) THEN x.return_type_end END AS return_type_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (5,6) THEN x.return_type_kind END AS return_type_kind FROM (SELECT n.__path,n.__start,n.__end,n.kind,n.text,n.line,n.parent_start,n.parent_end,n.parent_kind,n.parent_start AS ancestor_start,n.parent_end AS ancestor_end,n.parent_kind AS ancestor_kind,n.name_start,n.name_end,n.name_kind,n.name_source,n.left_start,n.left_end,n.left_kind,n.right_start,n.right_end,n.right_kind,n.value_start,n.value_end,n.value_kind,n.type_start,n.type_end,n.type_kind,n.function_start,n.function_end,n.function_kind,n.arguments_start,n.arguments_end,n.arguments_kind,n.object_start,n.object_end,n.object_kind,n.object_source,n.attribute_source,n.parameters_start,n.parameters_end,n.parameters_kind,n.return_type_start,n.return_type_end,n.return_type_kind,CASE WHEN n.kind IN ('identifier','concatenated_string','string','argument_list','expression_statement','block') THEN 0 WHEN n.kind IN ('call') THEN 1 WHEN n.kind IN ('attribute') THEN 2 WHEN n.kind IN ('keyword_argument') THEN 3 WHEN n.kind IN ('assignment','augmented_assignment','return_statement') THEN 4 WHEN n.kind IN ('class_definition','decorated_definition','function_definition') THEN 6 ELSE 5 END AS grp FROM sel_sfp s JOIN py_nodes n ON n.__path=s.__path) x

stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT *,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,
 parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent,
 ancestor_kind||':'||ancestor_start||':'||ancestor_end AS edge_parent,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal
 FROM syntax_rows

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

stages.name: ownership
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,id,fn,cls,top_fn) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='class_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END FROM nodes n
 LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE parent.id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT child.__path,child.id,CASE WHEN child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.fn END,CASE WHEN child.kind='class_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.cls END,CASE WHEN owned.top_fn IS NULL AND child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.top_fn END
 FROM owned JOIN edges e ON e.__path=owned.__path AND e.src=owned.id
 JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=e.__path AND child.id=e.dst) SELECT * FROM owned

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute'

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

stages.name: arguments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,c.id AS call,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.id ORDER BY n.__start)-1 AS position FROM calls c JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=c.__path AND n.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('comment','keyword_argument','list_splat','dictionary_splat')

stages.name: keywords
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS call,k.id AS keyword,k.__start AS keyword_start,kn.text AS name,v.id AS value,v.__start,v.__end,v.text,v.kind FROM calls c JOIN nodes k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end AND k.kind='keyword_argument' JOIN nodes kn ON kn.__path=k.__path AND kn.id=k.name_kind||':'||k.name_start||':'||k.name_end JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.id=k.value_kind||':'||k.value_start||':'||k.value_end

stages.name: descendants
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,root,node,expand) AS (SELECT __path,id,id,kind NOT IN ('module','block','expression_statement','argument_list','decorated_definition','type') FROM nodes UNION SELECT w.__path,w.root,e.dst,w.expand FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.__path=w.__path AND e.src=w.node WHERE w.expand) SELECT __path,root,node FROM walk

stages.name: assignments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,l.id AS target,l.kind AS target_kind,l.text AS target_text,r.id AS value,r.kind AS expr_kind,r.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end LEFT JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='assignment'

stages.name: parameters
stages.query:
SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,p.id,p.kind,p.text,n.text AS name,p.type_kind||':'||p.type_start||':'||p.type_end AS annotation,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id ORDER BY p.__start)-1 AS position FROM functions f JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.parent=f.parameters_kind||':'||f.parameters_start||':'||f.parameters_end JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND (n.id=p.id AND p.kind='identifier' OR n.parent=p.id AND n.ordinal=0 AND n.kind='identifier')
 WHERE p.kind IN ('identifier','typed_parameter','default_parameter','typed_default_parameter')

stages.name: contexts
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE class_parents(__path,id,name,parent) AS (SELECT n.__path,n.id,n.name_source,own.cls FROM nodes n LEFT JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.edge_parent WHERE n.kind='class_definition'), class_names(__path,id,name) AS (SELECT __path,id,name FROM class_parents WHERE parent IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.id,p.name||'.'||c.name FROM class_names p JOIN class_parents c ON c.__path=p.__path AND c.parent=p.id) SELECT f.*,coalesce(qualified.name,'') AS class_name,rx_matches(f.name,'_lazy$') OR f.name IN ('compile','lower','post_op','pre_op','preprocess') OR f.name='pending_pipeline_effects' OR rx_matches(f.name,'^apply_.*_effect$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes w WHERE w.__path=f.__path AND w.id=f.parent AND w.kind='decorated_definition' AND rx_matches(w.text,'(?m)^\s*@(?:[\w.]*\.)?pure_lazy\b')) AS planning, f.name='preprocess' AS preprocess,substr(f.name,-11)='sql_builder' AND f.name NOT IN ('compile','lower','post_op','pre_op','preprocess') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameters p JOIN nodes ann ON ann.__path=p.__path AND ann.id=p.annotation WHERE p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=f.id AND rx_matches(ann.text,'\bCompilationContext\b')) AS ctx_helper,f.__path='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/backend_profiles.py' AND rx_matches(f.name,'component|components|score|scores') AS provider_helper,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameters p WHERE p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=f.id AND p.name='runtime_refs') AND (rx_matches(f.name,'^materialize_.*builder$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameters p JOIN nodes ann ON ann.__path=p.__path AND ann.id=p.annotation WHERE p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=f.id AND rx_matches(ann.text,'\bRuntimeBuilderSpec\b'))) AS materializer FROM functions f JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=f.__path AND own.id=f.id AND own.top_fn=f.id LEFT JOIN class_names qualified ON qualified.__path=f.__path AND qualified.id=own.cls

stages.name: body_nodes
stages.query: SELECT own.__path,own.top_fn AS fn,own.id AS node FROM ownership own JOIN contexts c ON c.__path=own.__path AND c.id=own.top_fn

stages.name: callback_parameters
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT c.__path,c.id AS fn,p.name,k.name AS callback_kind,p.position FROM contexts c JOIN calls call ON call.__path=c.__path AND call.__start>=c.__start AND call.__end<=c.__end AND call.callee='CompiledStep' JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=call.__path AND k.call=call.id AND k.name IN ('post_op','post_op_with_refs') AND k.kind='identifier' JOIN functions nested ON nested.__path=c.__path AND nested.name=k.text AND nested.__start>c.__start AND nested.__end<=c.__end JOIN parameters p ON p.__path=nested.__path AND p.fn=nested.id WHERE p.position IN (1,2)

stages.name: parameter_kinds
stages.query: SELECT p.__path,p.fn,p.name,'authority' AS kind FROM parameters p LEFT JOIN nodes ann ON ann.__path=p.__path AND ann.id=p.annotation WHERE p.name IN ('txn','read_txn','write_txn','conn','connection','sql_conn') OR rx_matches(coalesce(ann.text,''),'\b(?:ReadTransaction|SyncDatabaseConnection|SyncSqlConnection|WriteTransaction)\b') UNION SELECT p.__path,p.fn,p.name,'provider' FROM parameters p JOIN nodes ann ON ann.__path=p.__path AND ann.id=p.annotation WHERE rx_matches(ann.text,'\b(?:CrossBranchQueryProvider|HybridSearchProvider|VectorCandidateProvider|VersionedLoweringProvider|VersionedStorageProvider)\b') UNION SELECT p.__path,p.fn,p.name,'runtime_value' FROM parameters p LEFT JOIN nodes ann ON ann.__path=p.__path AND ann.id=p.annotation LEFT JOIN contexts c ON c.__path=p.__path AND c.id=p.fn WHERE p.name='resolved' OR rx_matches(coalesce(ann.text,''),'\bResolvedRefs\b') OR c.materializer AND p.name='runtime_refs' UNION SELECT p.__path,p.fn,p.name,'carrier' FROM parameters p LEFT JOIN nodes ann ON ann.__path=p.__path AND ann.id=p.annotation WHERE p.name IN ('hydrator','runtime_hydrator','runtime_refs') OR rx_matches(coalesce(ann.text,''),'\bHydrator\b') UNION SELECT __path,fn,name,CASE WHEN callback_kind='post_op_with_refs' AND position=2 THEN 'runtime_value' ELSE 'carrier' END FROM callback_parameters WHERE position=1 OR callback_kind='post_op_with_refs' AND position=2 UNION SELECT __path,fn,name,'carrier' FROM callback_parameters WHERE callback_kind='post_op_with_refs' AND position=2

stages.name: string_values
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start,__end,value FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_strings_0 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM raw_strings_1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM raw_strings_2) UNION SELECT n.__path,n.__start,n.__end,s.value FROM assignments a JOIN nodes stmt ON stmt.__path=a.__path AND stmt.id=a.parent JOIN nodes root ON root.__path=stmt.__path AND root.id=stmt.parent AND root.kind='module' JOIN (SELECT * FROM raw_strings_0 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM raw_strings_1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM raw_strings_2) s ON s.__path=a.__path AND s.__start=a.right_start AND s.__end=a.right_end JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=a.__path AND n.kind='identifier' AND n.text=a.target_text WHERE a.target_kind='identifier'

stages.name: special_attributes
stages.query: SELECT b.__path,b.fn,a.id AS node,CASE WHEN a.object_text='ctx' AND a.attr IN ('materialized_pipeline','sql_connection','txn') THEN 'context' ELSE 'carrier' END AS owner,a.attr FROM attributes a JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.node=a.id WHERE a.object_text='ctx' AND a.attr IN ('materialized_pipeline','sql_connection','txn') OR a.attr IN ('_conn','_serverplan_runtime_txn','_serverplan_sql_conn','_txn','conn','connection','sql_conn','txn') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameter_kinds p WHERE p.__path=b.__path AND p.fn=b.fn AND p.name=a.object_text AND p.kind='carrier') UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,c.id,CASE WHEN receiver.text='ctx' AND c.full_callee='getattr' THEN 'context' ELSE 'carrier' END,s.value FROM calls c JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.node=c.id JOIN arguments receiver ON receiver.__path=c.__path AND receiver.call=c.id AND receiver.position=0 JOIN arguments key ON key.__path=c.__path AND key.call=c.id AND key.position=1 JOIN string_values s ON s.__path=key.__path AND s.__start=key.__start AND s.__end=key.__end WHERE c.full_callee='getattr' AND receiver.kind='identifier' AND (receiver.text='ctx' AND s.value IN ('materialized_pipeline','sql_connection','txn') OR s.value IN ('_conn','_serverplan_runtime_txn','_serverplan_sql_conn','_txn','conn','connection','sql_conn','txn') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameter_kinds p WHERE p.__path=b.__path AND p.fn=b.fn AND p.name=receiver.text AND p.kind='carrier')) UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,c.id,'carrier',s.value FROM calls c JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.node=c.id JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.id=c.callee_id JOIN arguments key ON key.__path=c.__path AND key.call=c.id AND key.position=0 JOIN string_values s ON s.__path=key.__path AND s.__start=key.__start AND s.__end=key.__end WHERE c.callee='get' AND s.value IN ('_conn','_serverplan_runtime_txn','_serverplan_sql_conn','_txn','conn','connection','sql_conn','txn') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameter_kinds p WHERE p.__path=b.__path AND p.fn=b.fn AND p.name=a.object_text AND p.kind='carrier') UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id,'carrier',s.value FROM nodes n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id JOIN nodes receiver ON receiver.__path=n.__path AND receiver.id=n.value_kind||':'||n.value_start||':'||n.value_end JOIN nodes key ON key.__path=n.__path AND key.parent=n.id AND key.id!=receiver.id JOIN string_values s ON s.__path=key.__path AND s.__start=key.__start AND s.__end=key.__end WHERE n.kind='subscript' AND receiver.kind='identifier' AND s.value IN ('_conn','_serverplan_runtime_txn','_serverplan_sql_conn','_txn','conn','connection','sql_conn','txn') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameter_kinds p WHERE p.__path=b.__path AND p.fn=b.fn AND p.name=receiver.text AND p.kind='carrier')

query.template: WITH RECURSIVE runtime(__path,name) AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.__path,c.name FROM contexts c JOIN special_attributes a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.fn=c.id AND a.owner='carrier' WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameter_kinds p WHERE p.__path=c.__path AND p.fn=c.id AND p.kind='carrier') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.__path,c.name FROM contexts c JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.fn=c.id JOIN calls call ON call.__path=b.__path AND call.id=b.node AND call.callee_kind='identifier' JOIN runtime r ON r.__path=call.__path AND r.name=call.callee WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments arg JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=arg.__path AND d.root=arg.id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.node AND n.kind='identifier' JOIN parameter_kinds p ON p.__path=c.__path AND p.fn=c.id AND p.name=n.text AND p.kind='carrier' WHERE arg.__path=call.__path AND arg.call=call.id)) SELECT __path,name,'runtime_authority' AS kind FROM runtime UNION SELECT c.__path,c.name,'authority' FROM contexts c JOIN nodes ann ON ann.__path=c.__path AND ann.id=c.return_type_kind||':'||c.return_type_start||':'||c.return_type_end WHERE rx_matches(ann.text,'\b(?:ReadTransaction|SyncDatabaseConnection|SyncSqlConnection|WriteTransaction)\b') UNION SELECT c.__path,c.name,'provider' FROM contexts c JOIN nodes ann ON ann.__path=c.__path AND ann.id=c.return_type_kind||':'||c.return_type_start||':'||c.return_type_end WHERE rx_matches(ann.text,'\b(?:CrossBranchQueryProvider|HybridSearchProvider|VectorCandidateProvider|VersionedLoweringProvider|VersionedStorageProvider)\b') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.__path,entry.key,kind.value FROM contexts c,json_each(CAST(X'{}' AS TEXT)) entry,json_each(entry.value) kind

stages.name: expression_edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,id AS dst,object AS src FROM attributes UNION SELECT __path,id,receiver FROM calls WHERE receiver IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT __path,id,value_kind||':'||value_start||':'||value_end FROM nodes WHERE kind='subscript'

stages.name: identifier_nodes
stages.query: SELECT __path,id,text,kind FROM nodes WHERE kind='identifier'

stages.name: taints
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE taint(__path,fn,node,kind) AS (SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id,p.kind FROM body_nodes b JOIN identifier_nodes n ON n.__path=b.__path AND n.id=b.node AND n.kind='identifier' JOIN parameter_kinds p ON p.__path=b.__path AND p.fn=b.fn AND p.name=n.text WHERE p.kind!='carrier' UNION SELECT __path,fn,node,'authority' FROM special_attributes WHERE owner='carrier' OR attr IN ('txn','sql_connection') UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,c.id,r.kind FROM body_nodes b JOIN calls c ON c.__path=b.__path AND c.id=b.node JOIN return_kinds r ON (r.__path=c.__path OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_mode)) AND r.name=c.callee UNION SELECT t.__path,t.fn,e.dst,t.kind FROM taint t JOIN expression_edges e ON e.__path=t.__path AND e.src=t.node JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=t.__path AND b.fn=t.fn AND b.node=e.dst UNION SELECT t.__path,t.fn,n.id,t.kind FROM taint t JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=t.__path AND a.value=t.node JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.fn=t.fn AND b.node=a.id JOIN identifier_nodes n ON n.__path=b.__path AND n.kind='identifier' AND n.text=a.target_text JOIN body_nodes uses ON uses.__path=n.__path AND uses.fn=t.fn AND uses.node=n.id WHERE a.target_kind='identifier' AND t.kind IN ('authority','provider','runtime_value')) SELECT * FROM taint

stages.name: semantic_values
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE semantic(__path,fn,node) AS (SELECT __path,fn,node FROM taints WHERE kind='runtime_value' UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id FROM body_nodes b JOIN identifier_nodes n ON n.__path=b.__path AND n.id=b.node AND n.kind='identifier' JOIN parameter_kinds p ON p.__path=b.__path AND p.fn=b.fn AND p.name=n.text AND p.kind='carrier' UNION SELECT s.__path,s.fn,d.root FROM semantic s JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=s.__path AND d.node=s.node UNION SELECT s.__path,s.fn,n.id FROM semantic s JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=s.__path AND a.value=s.node JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.fn=s.fn AND b.node=a.id JOIN identifier_nodes n ON n.__path=s.__path AND n.kind='identifier' AND n.text=a.target_text JOIN body_nodes uses ON uses.__path=n.__path AND uses.fn=s.fn AND uses.node=n.id WHERE a.target_kind='identifier') SELECT * FROM semantic

stages.name: direct_events
stages.query: SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'eager_sql' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM calls n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE n.callee IN ('execute_grammar_fetchall_direct','execute_grammar_fetchall_direct_async','execute_grammar_fetchall_with_params_direct','execute_grammar_fetchall_with_params_direct_async','execute_grammar_fetchone_direct','execute_grammar_fetchone_direct_async','execute_grammar_fetchone_with_params_direct','execute_grammar_fetchone_with_params_direct_async','grammar_effect_lazy','grammar_execute','grammar_execute_async','grammar_fetchall','grammar_fetchall_async','grammar_fetchone','grammar_fetchone_async','grammar_row_lazy','grammar_rows_lazy','grammar_scalar','grammar_scalar_async','grammar_value_lazy') OR n.callee_kind='identifier' AND n.callee IN ('execute','execute_async','execute_ddl','execute_ddl_async','executemany','executemany_async','fetchall','fetchall_async','fetchone','fetchone_async','scalar','scalar_async') OR (rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)conn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)conn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute_async$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)conn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchall$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)conn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchall_async$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)conn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchone$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)conn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchone_async$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)connection(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)connection(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute_async$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)connection(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchall$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)connection(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchall_async$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)connection(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchone$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)connection(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchone_async$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)cursor(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)cursor(?:\([^)]*\))?\.executemany$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)query(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)query(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute_async$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)query(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchall$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)query(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchall_async$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)query(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchone$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)query(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchone_async$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)txn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)txn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute_async$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)txn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchall$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)txn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchall_async$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)txn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchone$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)txn(?:\([^)]*\))?\.fetchone_async$')) OR n.callee IN ('execute','execute_async','execute_ddl','execute_ddl_async','executemany','executemany_async','fetchall','fetchall_async','fetchone','fetchone_async','scalar','scalar_async') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM taints t WHERE t.__path=b.__path AND t.fn=b.fn AND t.node=n.receiver AND t.kind='authority') UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'native_python_work' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM calls n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE n.callee IN ('create_usearch_index_class','deserialize_embedding','get_similarity_function','serialize_embedding') OR (rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)np(?:\([^)]*\))?\.array$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)np(?:\([^)]*\))?\.ascontiguousarray$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)np(?:\([^)]*\))?\.isinf$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)np(?:\([^)]*\))?\.isnan$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)numpy(?:\([^)]*\))?\.array$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)numpy(?:\([^)]*\))?\.ascontiguousarray$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)numpy(?:\([^)]*\))?\.isinf$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)numpy(?:\([^)]*\))?\.isnan$')) UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_callback' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM calls n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE n.callee='CompiledStep' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=n.__path AND k.call=n.id AND k.name IN ('post_op_with_refs','pre_op_with_refs')) UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'large_column' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM calls n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE n.callee IN ('explicit_plan_execution_scope','hydrate_many_post_op','hydrate_one_post_op','runtime_sql_conn_from_hydrator') OR n.callee='convert_row_to_model' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=n.__path AND k.call=n.id AND k.name='hydrate_large_columns' AND k.kind='true') UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'resolved_refs' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM calls n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE n.callee IN ('get','peek','resolve_server_ref') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attributes a JOIN nodes obj ON obj.__path=a.__path AND obj.id=a.object WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND a.id=n.callee_id AND (obj.kind='identifier' AND obj.text IN ('resolved','resolved_refs') OR obj.kind='attribute' AND obj.attribute_source IN ('resolved','resolved_refs') OR obj.kind NOT IN ('identifier','attribute') AND instr(obj.text,'resolved')>0)) UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'nested_execute' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM calls n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE n.callee IN ('execute_runtime_nested_steps_async','execute_runtime_nested_steps_sync') OR (rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)PlanExecutor(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)PlanExecutor(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute_async$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)executor(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute$') OR rx_matches(n.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)executor(?:\([^)]*\))?\.execute_async$')) UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'materialized_pipeline' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM attributes n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE n.attr='materialized_pipeline' UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'materialized_pipeline' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM nodes n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id JOIN special_attributes s ON s.__path=b.__path AND s.fn=b.fn AND s.node=n.id WHERE s.attr='materialized_pipeline' AND s.owner='context' UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'ctx_access' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM nodes n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id JOIN special_attributes s ON s.__path=b.__path AND s.fn=b.fn AND s.node=n.id WHERE s.owner='context' UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_authority' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM nodes n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id JOIN special_attributes s ON s.__path=b.__path AND s.fn=b.fn AND s.node=n.id WHERE s.owner='carrier' AND n.kind IN ('attribute','call') UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_authority' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM calls n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE n.callee IN ('active_pipeline_txn_for_callbacks') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM taints t WHERE t.__path=b.__path AND t.fn=b.fn AND t.node=n.id AND t.kind='runtime_authority') UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_authority' AS kind,0 AS priority FROM assignments n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM taints t WHERE t.__path=b.__path AND t.fn=b.fn AND t.node=n.value AND t.kind='runtime_authority') UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_value' AS kind,0 AS priority FROM assignments n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM taints t WHERE t.__path=b.__path AND t.fn=b.fn AND t.node=n.value AND t.kind='runtime_value') UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_value' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM calls n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM taints t WHERE t.__path=b.__path AND t.fn=b.fn AND t.kind='runtime_value' AND (t.node=n.id OR t.node=n.receiver OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND a.call=n.id AND a.id=t.node) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=n.__path AND k.call=n.id AND k.value=t.node))) UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_value' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM nodes n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE n.kind='subscript' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes obj JOIN taints t ON t.__path=obj.__path AND t.node=obj.id AND t.fn=b.fn AND t.kind='runtime_value' WHERE obj.__path=n.__path AND obj.id=n.value_kind||':'||n.value_start||':'||n.value_end AND obj.kind='identifier') OR n.kind='comparison_operator' AND rx_matches(n.text,'\bin\b') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes obj JOIN taints t ON t.__path=obj.__path AND t.node=obj.id AND t.fn=b.fn AND t.kind='runtime_value' WHERE obj.__path=n.__path AND obj.parent=n.id AND obj.kind='identifier') UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'provider_authority' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM calls n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM taints t WHERE t.__path=b.__path AND t.fn=b.fn AND t.node=n.receiver AND t.kind='provider') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM taints t WHERE t.__path=b.__path AND t.fn=b.fn AND t.kind='authority' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND a.call=n.id AND a.id=t.node) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=n.__path AND k.call=n.id AND k.value=t.node))) UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_semantic_projection' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM calls n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE n.callee IN ('all','any','filter','len','map','max','min','reversed','sorted','sum') AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a JOIN semantic_values s ON s.__path=a.__path AND s.fn=b.fn AND s.node=a.id WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND a.call=n.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k JOIN semantic_values s ON s.__path=k.__path AND s.fn=b.fn AND s.node=k.value WHERE k.__path=n.__path AND k.call=n.id)) OR n.callee IN ('count','index','reverse','sort') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM semantic_values s WHERE s.__path=b.__path AND s.fn=b.fn AND s.node=n.receiver) UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_semantic_projection' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM nodes n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE n.kind='subscript' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes slice WHERE slice.__path=n.__path AND slice.parent=n.id AND slice.kind='slice') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM semantic_values s WHERE s.__path=b.__path AND s.fn=b.fn AND s.node=n.value_kind||':'||n.value_start||':'||n.value_end) OR n.kind IN ('list_comprehension','set_comprehension','dictionary_comprehension','generator_expression') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes for_in JOIN nodes if_clause ON if_clause.__path=for_in.__path AND if_clause.parent=for_in.parent AND if_clause.kind='if_clause' JOIN semantic_values s ON s.__path=for_in.__path AND s.fn=b.fn AND s.node=for_in.right_kind||':'||for_in.right_start||':'||for_in.right_end WHERE for_in.__path=n.__path AND for_in.parent=n.id AND for_in.kind='for_in_clause') UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_semantic_projection' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM nodes n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE n.kind='for_statement' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM semantic_values s WHERE s.__path=b.__path AND s.fn=b.fn AND s.node=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN calls c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=n.__path AND d.root=n.id AND c.callee IN ('append','extend')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN nodes projection ON projection.__path=d.__path AND projection.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=n.__path AND d.root=n.id AND (projection.kind='subscript' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls c WHERE c.__path=projection.__path AND c.id=projection.id AND c.callee IN ('get','getattr'))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants fields JOIN nodes use_name ON use_name.__path=fields.__path AND use_name.id=fields.node AND use_name.kind='identifier' JOIN descendants targets ON targets.__path=n.__path AND targets.root=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end JOIN nodes name ON name.__path=targets.__path AND name.id=targets.node AND name.kind='identifier' AND name.text=use_name.text WHERE fields.__path=projection.__path AND fields.root=projection.id)) UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'runtime_sequence_projection' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM nodes n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE n.kind='for_statement' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM semantic_values s WHERE s.__path=b.__path AND s.fn=b.fn AND s.node=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN calls c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=n.__path AND d.root=n.id AND c.callee IN ('append','extend')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN nodes projection ON projection.__path=d.__path AND projection.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=n.__path AND d.root=n.id AND (projection.kind='subscript' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls c WHERE c.__path=projection.__path AND c.id=projection.id AND c.callee IN ('get','getattr'))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants fields JOIN nodes use_name ON use_name.__path=fields.__path AND use_name.id=fields.node AND use_name.kind='identifier' JOIN descendants targets ON targets.__path=n.__path AND targets.root=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end JOIN nodes name ON name.__path=targets.__path AND name.id=targets.node AND name.kind='identifier' AND name.text=use_name.text WHERE fields.__path=projection.__path AND fields.root=projection.id))

stages.name: direct_sinks
stages.query: SELECT __path,fn,node,kind FROM (SELECT d.*,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY d.__path,d.fn,d.kind ORDER BY d.priority,(SELECT count(*) FROM descendants a JOIN nodes ancestor ON ancestor.__path=a.__path AND ancestor.id=a.root WHERE a.__path=d.__path AND a.node=d.node AND ancestor.kind NOT IN ('module','block','expression_statement','argument_list','decorated_definition','parenthesized_expression','type')),n.__start,d.node) AS chosen FROM direct_events d JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.node) WHERE chosen=1

stages.name: call_graph
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT b.__path,b.fn,c.id AS node,target.id AS target FROM body_nodes b JOIN calls c ON c.__path=b.__path AND c.id=b.node JOIN contexts owner ON owner.__path=b.__path AND owner.id=b.fn JOIN contexts target ON target.__path=c.__path AND target.name=c.callee AND target.id!=b.fn WHERE c.callee_kind='identifier' AND target.class_name='' OR c.callee_kind='attribute' AND target.class_name=owner.class_name AND owner.class_name!='' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attributes a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.id=c.callee_id AND a.object_text IN ('self','cls'))

stages.name: builder_tokens
stages.query: SELECT __path,id AS node,attr AS name FROM attributes WHERE object_text='RuntimeBuilderName' UNION SELECT n.__path,n.id,s.value FROM nodes n JOIN string_values s ON s.__path=n.__path AND s.__start=n.__start AND s.__end=n.__end WHERE s.value!=''

stages.name: semantic_builders
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT token.name FROM contexts c JOIN direct_sinks sink ON sink.__path=c.__path AND sink.fn=c.id AND sink.kind='runtime_sequence_projection' JOIN body_nodes body ON body.__path=c.__path AND body.fn=c.id JOIN nodes comparison ON comparison.__path=body.__path AND comparison.id=body.node AND comparison.kind='comparison_operator' JOIN nodes operand ON operand.__path=comparison.__path AND operand.parent=comparison.id JOIN builder_tokens token ON token.__path=operand.__path AND token.node=operand.id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attributes spec WHERE spec.__path=comparison.__path AND spec.parent=comparison.id AND spec.object_text='spec' AND spec.attr='builder_name')

stages.name: builder_sites
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS node,token.name FROM calls c JOIN arguments arg ON arg.__path=c.__path AND arg.call=c.id AND arg.position=1 JOIN builder_tokens token ON token.__path=arg.__path AND token.node=arg.id WHERE c.callee='runtime_builder_post_op' OR c.callee='RuntimeBuilderSpec' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='builder_name') UNION SELECT c.__path,c.id,token.name FROM calls c JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name='builder_name' JOIN builder_tokens token ON token.__path=k.__path AND token.node=k.value WHERE c.callee='RuntimeBuilderSpec' OR c.callee='runtime_builder_post_op' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=1)

stages.name: project_seeds
stages.query: SELECT b.__path,b.fn,b.node,'builder' AS kind,0 AS priority FROM body_nodes b JOIN builder_sites site ON site.__path=b.__path AND site.node=b.node JOIN semantic_builders semantic ON semantic.name=site.name UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,c.id,'builder',1 FROM body_nodes b JOIN calls c ON c.__path=b.__path AND c.id=b.node WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM call_graph g WHERE g.__path=b.__path AND g.fn=b.fn AND g.node=c.id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contexts helper JOIN body_nodes own ON own.__path=helper.__path AND own.fn=helper.id JOIN builder_sites site ON site.__path=own.__path AND site.node=own.node JOIN semantic_builders semantic ON semantic.name=site.name WHERE helper.name=c.callee) UNION SELECT __path,fn,node,'semantic',0 FROM direct_sinks WHERE kind='runtime_semantic_projection'

stages.name: project_sinks
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE sink(__path,fn,node,kind,priority,route) AS (SELECT __path,fn,node,kind,priority,'|'||fn||'|' FROM project_seeds UNION SELECT g.__path,g.fn,s.node,s.kind,s.priority,s.route||g.fn||'|' FROM sink s JOIN call_graph g ON g.__path=s.__path AND g.target=s.fn WHERE instr(s.route,'|'||g.fn||'|')=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_seeds direct WHERE direct.__path=g.__path AND direct.fn=g.fn AND direct.kind=s.kind)) SELECT __path,fn,node,kind FROM (SELECT s.*,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY s.__path,s.fn,s.kind ORDER BY length(s.route),s.priority,n.__start,s.node,s.route) AS chosen FROM sink s JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=s.__path AND n.id=s.node) WHERE chosen=1

cases.scan_project_sources: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPT-028' AS issue,c.id AS identity,'project-builder' AS detector FROM contexts c JOIN project_sinks s ON s.__path=c.__path AND s.fn=c.id AND s.kind='builder' JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=s.__path AND n.id=s.node WHERE c.planning AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_sinks semantic WHERE semantic.__path=c.__path AND semantic.fn=c.id AND semantic.kind='semantic')

query.default: SELECT * FROM (SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPT-028' AS issue,c.id AS identity,'project-builder' AS detector FROM contexts c JOIN project_sinks s ON s.__path=c.__path AND s.fn=c.id AND s.kind='builder' JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=s.__path AND n.id=s.node WHERE c.planning AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_sinks semantic WHERE semantic.__path=c.__path AND semantic.fn=c.id AND semantic.kind='semantic')) WHERE 0
